description: [$0.001] Is this Solana token dangerous? A calibrated rug verdict whose probability is a MEASURED frequency (see get_scorecard), the concentration facts behind it, and how fast this band tends to collapse. Cheapest call, run it on every token; it decides whether inspect_token, token_identity or token_report is worth paying for. Does not name holders.
name: check_token

facts.description: Counts AND the share of supply behind each: snipers, insiders, fresh wallets, wallet groups,...
